prd.title: Inbox Rail
prd.overview: The Inbox Rail is the 240px left rail inside InboxDetail (per foundation §3.2). Compact ranked list with band pill + reporter badge icons. Used by WO-005 InboxDetail. Tier 3 (light) — narrow reconciliation of existing file.

scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/InboxRail.tsx (123 LOC); compact band + reporter icons; URL selection sync

requirement.title: 240px rail inside InboxDetail
requirement.description: Render as 240px rail component inside InboxDetail layout. Used via WO-005 InboxDetail three-column structure.

requirement.title: Compact per-row composition (band glyph + reporter icon + age)
requirement.description: Each rail row renders compact variants: BandPill (glyph + text, compact), reporter-badge chip (icon only, compact), age. Sized for 240px width.

acceptance.criterion: All three elements render in compact variant
Row fits within 240px width without overflow

requirement.title: Selection state syncs to URL
requirement.description: Selected rail row syncs to URL query string (incident_id). Loading URL pre-populates selection. Round-trips correctly.

requirement.title: Row click navigates to /inbox/:id
requirement.description: Click row → navigate to /inbox/:incident_id (parent InboxDetail). Mouse + keyboard (Enter) both supported. Selection state preserved in URL.

requirement.title: Selected row visually highlighted
requirement.description: Selected rail row shows visual highlight (background or border per lockdown tokens). Highlight persists across re-renders.

acceptance.criterion: Highlight uses --color-primary-tint or foundation token (not raw color)

requirement.title: Area Labels per foundation §13
requirement.description: Implement Area Labels per foundation §13: inbox-rail, …-row, …-band-pill, …-reporter-badge-chip, …-age.

acceptance.criterion: All Area Labels present with matching id and aria-label

requirement.title: i18n keys (compact labels; EN + BN)
requirement.description: Add compact labels to inboxCommon.json (en + bn). EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: Reconciliation: confirm compact variants fit 240px
requirement.description: Verify compact band + reporter badges fit within 240px width; verify URL selection sync round-trips; verify click navigation.

acceptance.criterion: Compact variant width test passes (240px constraint)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Render rail; assert row widths fit within 240px. Compact variants fit.
Click row; assert URL contains incident_id. Reload from URL; assert row highlighted. URL sync works.
Click row; assert navigation to /inbox/:id. Navigation works.
